## What's changing

## Checklist

- [ ] The file is in `_providers/` and its name is lowercase with hyphens (e.g. `my-team-name.md`)  
- [ ] The contact email is correct and the contact has agreed to be listed  
- [ ] The optional paragraph below the front matter is about 500 characters or less  
- [ ] I'm a member of this team, or I have the team's permission to make this change
- [ ] Answers were selected or unselected by adding or removing `# `, without retyping them
- [ ] Each CHOOSE ONE question has exactly one line without `# ` (or none, if it doesn't apply)
- [ ] Each service says `not offered`, `offered`, or `strength`, with no more than five `strength`
- [ ] The `updated:` date is today's date
